environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'internal-api-geo-restrict' that blocks non-US source IPs, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The task IAM role has an inline policy with a Deny on s3:* to prevent data exfiltration. The ECS task uses a read-only root filesystem with /var/data mounted as an EFS volume. CloudWatch Container Insights enabled. The ALB access logs are shipped to a SIEM with a 15-minute alert threshold on 4xx spike. VPC Flow Logs enabled.

config.monitoring: CloudWatch Container Insights, ALB access logs to SIEM, 15min 4xx alert
config.network: VPC Flow Logs enabled, private subnet
